beats.line: Tombstone opens with a probing hit on Minotaur.
beats.fact: Tombstone is a full-body spinner, one of the most feared in the league

beats.line: Minotaur answers, forks scraping Tombstone's shell.
Another glancing blow — Minotaur backs toward the wall.
Tombstone's bar connects square! Minotaur staggers.
beats.fact: Tombstone's spinning bar can generate devastating hits

beats.line: Minotaur's lift catches nothing but empty air.
Minotaur gets under it — Tombstone is flipped!
beats.fact: Minotaur's hydraulic forks are built to flip and self-right

beats.line: Tombstone rights itself and slams straight back in.
Both bots collide center-arena, no clear winner there.
Minotaur's forks skid harmlessly off Tombstone's armor.
Tombstone connects again — Minotaur wobbling badly.
beats.fact: Tombstone is known for finishing fights quickly once it connects

beats.line: Tombstone shrugs off a weak counter-hit.
Another direct hit — Minotaur's drive looks damaged.
Minotaur tries to turtle up against the wall.
Tombstone drives Minotaur straight into the arena wall!
beats.fact: Minotaur has weathered flips from spinners before

beats.line: Scramble at the wall — sparks and spinning metal.
Minotaur can barely turn to face the spinner now.
Tombstone circles, looking for the finishing angle.
One more hit like that and it's over for Minotaur.
Minotaur's drive train is failing before our eyes.
MASSIVE HIT! Tombstone launches Minotaur — that's a KO!
beats.fact: Tombstone has one of the highest KO rates in BattleBots
